4 wars. 24 hours. Here's what changed. ⬇️

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,691) — Putin told Trump peace talks are "unlikely" right now. Russian strikes killed 30+ in Kramatorsk and 22 in Pryluky this week, while Ukraine pushes Russian troops back near Lyman.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 226) — Houthi missiles hit Riyadh's main airport. The Saudi-led coalition says it struck 136 Houthi targets, and Trump says he'll consider joining. Hormuz traffic is still ~75% below pre-war.

🇵🇸 GAZA — The ceasefire turned one year old. 8 were killed that day; 1,481 since the truce began (Gaza Health Ministry).

🇸🇩 SUDAN — The army advances in Kordofan and Darfur; an RSF drone hit a university dorm in El Obeid (5 killed).

caption_facebook:
WORLD AT WAR: Sunday, Oct 11, 2026
4 fronts, 24 hours. Here's what changed.

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,691)
• Putin told Trump on Friday that immediate peace talks are "unlikely," blaming Ukrainian drone attacks.
• A Russian bomb hit two buses in Kramatorsk, killing at least 30. A missile on an apartment block in Pryluky killed 22, including 5 children.
• Ukraine is retaking villages south of Lyman. Even the pro-Kremlin channel Rybar admits Russian losses there.
• Germany's Chancellor Merz visited Kyiv and pledged €1.3bn in military aid.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 226)
• Houthi missiles struck Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. Casualty reports still differ between outlets.
• The Saudi-led coalition says it hit 136 Houthi targets. Trump says he'll consider joining the strikes.
• 11 attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz in the first week of October (UKMTO). Traffic is still about 75% below pre-war levels.

🇵🇸 GAZA
• The US-backed ceasefire marked one year on Oct 10. At least 8 people were killed that day, including an 8-year-old girl.
• Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,481 people have been killed since the truce began. 100+ aid groups say it "exists in name only."

🇸🇩 SUDAN
• The army retook Al-Mazroub in North Kordofan; allied forces took Bir Saliba in West Darfur.
• An RSF drone strike on a university dorm in El Obeid killed 5 and injured 47.
• The UN says 33M+ people need aid, and famine threatens 14 areas.

WHAT TO WATCH: Will the U.S. join strikes on the Houthis? Can Ukraine take Kryva Luka? Will a U.S. peace proposal reach Moscow?

Sources: Al Jazeera, Times of Israel, Iran International, UKMTO, ISW, Ayin/allAfrica, UN OCHA. Figures are as reported by those outlets.
